facts.text: webots_drone registers webots_drone/DroneEnvContinuous-v0 with entry point webots_drone.envs:DroneEnvContinuous
DroneEnvContinuous is a gym.Env whose action space is a Box built from the simulation's control ranges
The Mavic control ranges are pi/12 rad for roll, pi/12 rad for pitch, pi rad for yaw and 5 for altitude, returned as symmetric low and high limits
The 22-element vector observation is orientation and angular velocity, position and speed, north_rad and nine distance sensors
With is_pixels=False the observation space is a 22-element float32 Box with infinite bounds
The default observation configuration is a 3x84x84 uint8 camera image
The forest_fire world's basic time step is 8 ms
The forest_fire world's FlightArea is 100 by 100

The constructor defaults are time_limit_seconds=60, max_no_action_seconds=5, frame_skip=125 (commented 1 s), goal_threshold=5, init_altitude=25, altitude_limits=[11,75], target_pos=2, target_dim=[7,3.5] and is_pixels=True
set_reaction_intervals sets the frame interval to frame_skip - 5 to frame_skip + 5
step draws the number of Webots steps from the frame interval with the environment's numpy generator
The time limit and no-action limit are converted to Webots steps from the simulation's basic time step
get_flight_area halves the world's FlightArea size and appends the altitude limits
reset calls seed, sim.reset, play_fast, sync, set_target and lift_uav, then returns the state and info
step returns observation, reward, terminated, truncated and info
The reward combines orientation, distance, velocity and elevation terms
A goal adds 10 to the reward and truncates the episode, and a terminal state subtracts 2
The final states are no action, flipped, max distance, inside risk zone and out of flight area
The seed method seeds the environment generator, the simulation and the virtual target
The environment is an interface for Webots R2023b and needs WEBOTS_HOME and LD_LIBRARY_PATH set
The dependencies are gym==0.26.0, simple_pid==2.0.0 and opencv-python==4.8.1.*

determinism.notes: reset(seed) seeds the fake's random generator and its step-length draws, so one implementation repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; upstream seeds numpy's generator, the Webots world and the virtual target, so a seed gives different trajectories on the two

gaps: kinematic stand-in: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, collisions, aerodynamics, actuator dynamics or sensor noise; the attitude-to-speed gain and the initial pose are model data, and the fake was never compared with a Webots run
NOT COVERED: the default 3x84x84 RGB uint8 camera observation (is_pixels=True, drone_continuous.py:61-69); this package serves the 22-element vector observation (is_pixels=False)

one cap.world.step.v1 tick is one upstream env.step, which applies the action over a random 120-130 Webots base steps of 8 ms (nominally 1000 ms, 960-1040 ms); timestep_ms is the nominal macro-step, not the 8 ms physics step, and the fake uses one integration step per environment step
the Webots supervisor, world and drone controllers are not imported or run; the sim backend (gym.make) was not run
no rendering and no snapshot/restore: the environment exposes no set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
